thread:
alex: Heads up — customer report: batch /rerank is returning fewer candidates than sent for multi-query payloads. Seems to truncate per-query lists mid-stream. Request id: req_0x9a7f

maria: ugh, can you paste the request body + server logs? is this only with large payloads? :thinking_face:

alex: short repro attached below. They send 3 queries with 50 candidates each, but response only includes 30 for query[1], 50 for query[2], and 0 for query[3]. No error code, 200 with shorter arrays.

alex: ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-rerank-v1",
  "queries": [
    {"id": "q1", "text": "how to reset password"},
    {"id": "q2", "text": "billing invoice missing"},
    {"id": "q3", "text": "api rate limit"}
  ],
  "candidates": [  // flattened list, expected per-query slicing on server
    /* 150 total candidate items (50 per query) */
    {"id":"c1","text":"..."}, {"id":"c2","text":"..."} /* ... truncated in snippet */
  ]
}
```

raj: do we have any size/length guards in the batch parser? maybe Content-Length mismatch or newline in JSON string caused partial read.

support-bot: Deploy 2026-03-16T09:12:31 to rerank-service completed. No immediate alerts.

maria: I pulled logs for req_0x9a7f — upstream parser logged "payload_read_incomplete" then continued; downstream scorer produced results for N candidates it actually received. No exception thrown.

maria: stack snippet: ```
2026-03-16T09:14:02.123 INFO parser: received bytes: 123456
2026-03-16T09:14:02.124 WARN parser: expected 234567 bytes but socket closed, marking truncated input
2026-03-16T09:14:02.125 INFO rerank: scored 80 candidates across 3 queries
```

alex: customer says they used python requests with a streaming generator to build body. Could be chunking differences. Also they hit our 1MB per-request soft limit historically but this was ~900KB so under limit.

raj: hypothesis: our parser expects Content-Length header OR uses chunked transfer; if client used transfer-encoding: chunked but omitted final zero-length chunk due to generator bug, we might treat connection close as EOF and mistakenly accept partial payload. Need to repro with streaming client.

sophie: I tried a quick repro with python requests generator that yields pieces without final yield(None). I can reproduce truncated candidate lists — server logs same "expected X got Y". Sending identical payload with a single requests.post(json=payload) works fine.

maria: thanks. Can you include the exact generator code you used? also paste the HTTP headers we see on ingress so we can distinguish chunked vs content-length.

sophie: small example: ```py
def stream_payload():
  yield b'{"model": "redwood-rerank-v1", "queries": ['
  for i in range(3):
    yield json.dumps({"id": f"q{i}", "text": "test"}).encode() + b','
  yield b'], "candidates": ['
  for c in candidates:
    yield json.dumps(c).encode() + b','
  # oops forgot to yield the closing ] and } explicitly in some branch

requests.post(url, data=stream_payload(), headers={"Transfer-Encoding": "chunked"})
```

maria: cool that's the smoking gun — missing terminal bytes. For mitigation: 1) short-term: detect truncated JSON and return 4xx (bad request) instead of silently scoring partial payloads; 2) better: fail-fast on parser when expected content-length mismatch or incomplete JSON; 3) doc note about streaming client requirements.

alex: can we push a quick patch to change behavior to 400 when parser notices truncated input? Prefer that over silent scoring. Also add a warning in Console when request size approaches limit.

raj: I'll open a PR to the rerank-service parser: validate full JSON parse, raise ClientParseError -> return 400 with code RERANK_TRUNCATED_PAYLOAD. We'll also log request_id + expected/received bytes.

sophie: I'll prepare a minimal test that streams incomplete body to assert 400 returned. Also pinging customer with repro steps and recommended client change (final closing yield or use json param).

maria: assign me to rollout — want to monitor for any regressions; add a sampling rule to capture a few requests that previously produced mismatched counts for postmortem.

alex: thanks all. Action items: raj PR, sophie test + customer note, maria rollout + sampling. Customer notified and happy with plan. :thumbsup:
